diamond.descripcion: An uncommon gem found in the deep layers of the world. It is the material behind high-end gear before netherite.

stick.descripcion: A basic material that forms the handle of nearly every tool and weapon. Crafted from planks and effectively unlimited.

emerald.descripcion: The currency of villager trading. It is not used as gear material, but it unlocks everything villagers sell.

book.descripcion: Crafted from paper and leather. A common ingredient in librarian trades and at the enchanting table.

enchanted_book.descripcion: Holds an enchantment until it is applied to a piece of gear on an anvil. It is the only practical way to obtain treasure enchantments.

lectern.descripcion: The block that turns an unemployed villager into a librarian. Breaking and replacing it rerolls their trades.
